l fork, deterministic branch comparison
# dsh-canvas
A conversation-branch canvas for DeepSeek Harness: draw the current workspace's session lineage as a
full-bleed canvas, fork from any message, run two approaches in parallel, and compare them determin
istically. 中文说明见 `README.zh-CN.md`。
| The lineage canvas — fork from any message, watch branches run live | The agent war room — every s
ubagent on the web, pulsing as it works |
**Try it without installing**: the online demo runs the real UI against synthetic data. Locally: `pn
pm run demo`, then open `demo/index.html`.
> Target: DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. Every DSH API used here was verified against the local checkout (commit
`639ed01539`), not against online docs.
## What it solves
DSH supports forking natively and the sidebar lists sessions, but:
1. **Lineage is invisible** — forked children sit flat next to ordinary sessions; the parent/child r

elation is dropped.
2. **Forking is buried** — only in the sidebar row menu and the chat turn footer

, so you cannot plan *where* to branch without seeing the whole shape.
3. **Parallel exploration has
no live view** — running two approaches at once gives you no single place to watch both or compare
view** — running two approaches at once gives you no single place to watch both or compare results.
## v1 capabilities
- **Lineage canvas** — workspace sessions laid out left→right by `parentSession`. A linear chain sta
ys on one row; only real branches spread downward. Zoom 0.4–2×, drag to pan, fit to view, search to
locate. Subagent sessions are conversation-internal, so they stay out of the lineage by default — ea
ch parent folds them into a 「机器人 ×N」 badge that jumps straight to its ⌖ web, and a toolbar toggle (子

代理) brings them back as nodes.
- **Fork from any message** — the detail panel lists the branch's own
turns with their real `seq` range and a 「⑂ fork here」 action. The cut is that row's own last event

seq, so it is **always a real event**.
- **Two launch modes** — 「run now」 queues the instruction int

o the child; 「create empty branch」 sends nothing at all.
- **Deterministic comparison** — compares o
nly events after each branch's `inheritedEventCount`, aligned positionally, never semantically. 「Car

ry conclusion」 produces an **editable draft** and never submits.
- **Three-state status** — confirme
d (idle/queued/failed/done), inferred (thinking/tool), unknown (disconnected). **Never infers idle f

rom silence.**
- **Live streaming output** — a running branch's in-flight assistant stream is visibl
e on the canvas: the node card shows the newest line (reasoning / answer / tool), and the selected b
ranch's detail panel shows the full live reasoning and answer text, updated per chunk and folded int
o the turn list when the durable message settles. While a stream is visible the status badge is driv

en by it (thinking vs tool), so a running node is no longer a guess.
- **Agent swarm web** — the ⌖ c
orner button on a node card opens that session's own live view: the parent agent at the center, its
subagents on the ring around it. When an agent emits, its spoke lights up and a glowing dot crawls t
oward the parent (spider-web effect), with the agent's newest line on its chip. The roster comes fro
m the session log's `subagent/catalog` events, so a freshly spawned agent joins the web instantly.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness (desktop app or CLI), pinned to `0.2.0-rc.2` — see the version matrix
- Node.js ≥
22.19, pnpm 10+ (`corepack enable`), Git

## Explicit v1 limits
| Limit | Why |
| Branches share one working directory | The public fork API has no `cwd`; the UI carries a permanen

t 「⚠ parallel write」 warning. |
| The detail panel is a snapshot | Selecting a node reads once and r

eleases immediately, so no session is pinned open. |
| Carry-forward goes to the clipboard | v1 has

no composer handle. |
| No persistent mainline marker | Only 「continue in this branch」. |
| No auto-
pick, no semantic summary | Positional alignment is the only rule that gives the same answer twice.
ick, no semantic summary | Positional alignment is the only rule that gives the same answer twice. |

## ⚠️ Known publish blocker
`dsh-canvas` is **already taken on npm** (`0.0.1`, described as "Infinite canvas for the DeepSeek Ha
rness - name reserved", repo `dushaobindoudou/dsh-canvas`). Publishing requires renaming to `@<scope
>/dsh-canvas` and updating `package.json` `name`, the `name:` in `cordis.patch.yml`, and `PLUGIN_ID`
in `tsdown.config.ts`. Until that decision is made, this GitHub repository is the distribution chan
`tsdown.config.ts`. Until that decision is made, this GitHub repository is the distribution channel.
**Do not rename during local development**: the loader id changes, the installed profile row stops m
atching, and the verified M0 install breaks.
